## Django Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements - Django project with REST Framework
- [x] Scaffold the Project - Django structure created with manage.py, settings, urls
- [x] Customize the Project - Configuration with environment variables support
- [x] Install Required Extensions - No extensions needed for Django
- [x] Compile the Project - Virtual environment created and dependencies installed via pip
- [x] Create and Run Task - Django run server task created
- [ ] Launch the Project
- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete - README.md created with setup instructions
